what_this_proves: The executive plans past its three shapes without trusting the planner: a model proposes only ids, kinds, inputs, preconditions, minimums, timeouts, retries, loops and reasons, the fixed risk/compensation/evidence fields come from the kind's profile and the same validator judges every graph (rule, model or the owner's own); steps branch on a failure, depend strictly on a verification, loop bounded until a minimum is met and park for the owner's recorded yes while their siblings keep running; the research shape builds its two artifacts side by side; and every plan explains each step.

measured_first.before: RuleBasedExecutivePlanner: three shapes, everything else PlanningClarificationNeeded; ClaudeExecutivePlanner.plan raised NotImplementedError; Precondition checks step_done/none only (plus four unused names treated as satisfied); no Repeat, no rationale, no planner tag; the research shape chained s3 -> s4; run_dict had no awaiting_step; POST /v1/executive/runs took a directive only; the Cockpit had three chips.
